transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… they brought me in after what happened at the fair. I was supposed to be giving a talk, and I climbed up onto the tractor and started jerking the controls around, trying to show everybody this “new pattern” I had in my head. People were yelling at me to stop, but I just… couldn’t make myself stop.
During that time, did you feel unusually high, excited, or irritable?

Yes. Some mornings I wake up feeling like the whole valley’s opening up just for me, and I’m grinning over nothing. But it can turn quick. If one of the hands questions what I’m doing, or my wife tells me to slow down, I snap at them like they’ve insulted my family.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people couldn't?

Yes. Out by the north pasture, mostly around dusk, I hear voices clear as day coming from the irrigation lines. They tell me which rows are poisoned and which ones are blessed. And it’s not just when I’m all wound up, either—it still happens on quieter weeks too.
Have there been times when you heard those voices for at least two weeks even though your mood was otherwise normal—not unusually high, irritable, or depressed?

Yes. There were stretches, several weeks at a time, where I wasn’t feeling especially fired up or grand, and I wasn’t down either. I felt more regular, I guess. But I could still hear the irrigation lines talking, and I still thought the farm data had hidden warnings in it.
When you get into those fired-up periods, do you need much less sleep than usual?

Yes. When I get like that, I hardly sleep. Most nights it’s maybe two or three hours in my chair, sometimes none at all, and then I’m up before sunup feeling charged like I can work the whole place like nothing happened.
When the voices talk to you, do they ever tell you that you have a special power or mission?

Yes. They don’t always say it that way, but they make it sound like I’m supposed to figure out which rows are poisoned and which ones are blessed. Like it’s on me to know and do something about it. This usually happens out by the north pasture, near dusk, from the irrigation lines.
Outside of the voices, have you also kept believing the farm data had hidden warnings during times when your mood felt normal?

Yes. Even when I feel pretty normal mood-wise, I still see those odd numbers in the yield maps and the drone reports and I know they mean something. My wife will show me the lender’s paperwork and say it’s all plain, nothing hidden, but I can’t shake it. It feels like coded warnings that people are trying to take the farm out from under me.
